pages.text: Tier 4 Mekanism unlocks the apex tech content: MekaSuit, MekaTool, QIO Network, Fusion Reactor, and Antimatter production.

$(bold)MekaSuit:$() The best armor in the pack for tech-path players. Modular, upgradeable, and powerful. Requires extensive Mekanism infrastructure to produce.$(br2)$(bold)MekaTool:$() All-in-one tool replacing pick, axe, shovel, hoe, and sword. Configurable modes. Endgame default tool.

$(bold)Fusion Reactor:$() Produces enormous amounts of RF. Building one is a T4 capstone project. Powers the late-game Mekanism factory comfortably.$(br2)$(bold)Antimatter:$() Produced via Particle Accelerator. Required for the highest Mythic Forge catalysts, the MekaSuit Mk2 upgrade, and exchangeable for Codex progression tokens.

$(bold)No book needed.$() Mekanism Generators and Tools are documented alongside the core mod at $(bold)mekanismmod.com$(). Focus on the Fission Reactor and Fusion Reactor at T4 — both require significant infrastructure.
